BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)

promises.opening: welcome to Bajaj Finance Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode, and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during this conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star then zero on your touchtone phone. I'm pleased to welcome Mr. Rajeev Jain, Vice Chairman and Managing Director; and Mr. Sandeep Jain, COO and CFO; and other senior members of the management team. I now invite Mr. Rajeev Jain for his opening remarks, post which we will open the floor for the Q&A session. Thank you, and over to you, Mr. Jain. Rajeev Jain: Thank you for hosting us. Very good evening to all of you, or good morning, depending on the geography you're in. Welcome to the BFL Q2 earnings call. The investor deck for Q2 has been uploaded on our website. I hope you had a chance to go through the same. I'll quickly focus on key updates for the quarter and our management assessment before Q&A. I expect to between 15 to 20 odd minutes. Let's quickly jump to Panel 4 in terms of the quarter went by. Overall, I would say it is an excellent quarter with strong performance across all key metrics, of AUM, new customer addition, credit cost, profit growth, ROA and ROE. AUM, as you can see, grew by 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores, delivering net AUM addition of close to INR 38,000 crores in the quarter. PBT grew by 29% to INR 8,537 crores in Q2. This is before the macroeconomic provision that we've created of another INR 337 crores to grew by 34% to INR 8,874 crores. PAT grew by 29% to INR6,367 crores. Before macro overlay provision, it grew by 34% to INR6,619 crores. In Q2, company booked just a tad below INR13.5 million new loans and added 4.5 million new customers. Overall customer franchise stood at just a tad below 129 million customers. ROA for the quarter came in at 4.6% and ROE came in at 20.6%. Opex to total income was 33% and net NPA came in at 42 basis points. Overall, I would say, a pretty good quarter for the firm and first half for the firm. In general, AUM growth was pretty secular. I'll quickly go through -- I've jumped actually to Panel 52. If you see, the growth is pretty secular, urban consumer finance grew by 43%, rural consumer finance by 63%. MFI grew on a low base, grew 54%, CV and Tractor on low base grew 89%, LAS grew 42%, captive book, as you're aware, as I've been talking for the last 2 quarters, continues to wind down and would create significant tailwinds for us in terms of credit costs as you move forward is now down to just INR2,400-odd crores. Bajaj Finance Limited October 19, 2026 Page 3 of 19 MSME grew by 3%. It should now start to grow actually. So, we should start to see as we get in the second half, a double-digit kind of growth momentum in the business. Gold loan book portfolio continued to grow, it's now 4.1% of balance sheet. It was just a tad above INR24,000 crores as of Q2. We added 320 odd gold loan branches during the quarter. Total network is now across 2,000 branches. It's at 2,022 branches, and we remain quite clear about ending the year with close to 2,800 on stand-alone gold branches. The rest of the business, as you can see, grew in the corridor of 20% to 30%. So, overall pretty secular growth across all lines of business, in a way, if I look at the gross loan growth because capital book is dialing down, you should add another INR1,000-odd crores that's virtually INR39,000 crores of book growth that we are principally talking about. These are fascinating numbers even for me, I would say. I didn't imagine we'll be growing quarterly between INR38,000 crores and INR39,000 crores on a run rate basis because that's been the case for the last two quarters now. I'll go back to panel 5, 6 and 7 to quickly give you highlights of the quarter. New loans grew 11% to 13.5 million. There is some level of noise in year-on-year number because last year's season was earlier this year’s sea
